title: Continuity profile domain types
intended_behavior: The domain package exposes continuity operating modes and service continuity profile contracts for Nostr kind 31400 definitions without adding runtime behavior.
observed_baseline: No dedicated service continuity profile domain contract existed before this change. A concurrent worker-domain change already introduced the ContinuityMode type in worker.go, so this feature adds the requested mode constants and profile types without redeclaring that type.
